environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' running with IAM Role 'arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/UserServiceRole-Scoped'. The role's trust policy restricts AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity to the specific service account. The DynamoDB permission policy includes a Condition block with 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' ForAllValues:StringEquals set to '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}' and a separate Condition 'dynamodb:Attributes' ForAllValues:StringEquals restricted to ['userId','email','role'] on the Scan action. A secondary inline policy with explicit Deny on dynamodb:Scan when 'dynamodb:Select' is not 'SPECIFIC_ATTRIBUTES'. The IRSA annotation maps to a service account with an STS session tag 'tenant_id' propagated from the originating request's x-tenant-id header via an Envoy sidecar that sets the AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME. Calico NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to port 50051 from pods with label 'app.kubernetes.io/component=api-gateway' only.

config.envoy_sidecar: propagates x-tenant-id as STS session tag
